data.text:
Season 3 of House of the Dragon hits HBO in June 2026 with eight episodes. It dives straight into the Dance of the Dragons arc from George R.R. Martin’s Fire & Blood. Targaryens fight, betray, and burn their way through battles and politics. The teaser and first trailer show war prep, tense standoffs, and hint at the Battle of the Gullet. Stakes are higher than ever. HBO has also confirmed a fourth season for 2028, proving the story isn’t slowing down.

Cast returns strong. Emma D’Arcy is Rhaenyra Targaryen, Matt Smith is Daemon, Olivia Cooke is Alicent Hightower, Rhys Ifans is Otto Hightower, and others come back. New faces like James Norton, Tommy Flanagan, Dan Fogler, Tom Cullen, Joplin Sibtain, and Barry Sloane promise fresh chaos. Filming wrapped in the UK by October 2025, with post-production pushing the visual spectacle fans expect. International distribution will cover streaming and broadcast partners in regions including the UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, and the Philippines.

So here’s the question. Will you watch the Targaryens destroy everything in their path, or are you ready for a season that leaves every throne and alliance in ashes?

data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY AHEAD OF RED LANTERN FESTIVAL 

LOOK: The Cebu City Transportation Office (CCTO) has issued a traffic advisory ahead of the Red Lantern Festival 2026 celebration on Saturday, Feb. 21, with a parade scheduled from 2 p.m. to 6 p.m. in Cebu City. 

CCTO said temporary traffic diversions and traffic management measures will be implemented along the parade route, which will start at Freedom Park, proceed along Magallanes Street, then turn right onto D. Jakosalem Street, left onto M. C. Briones Street, left onto M. J. Cuenco Avenue, left onto Magallanes Extension, left onto P. Burgos Street, and end at the Plaza Sugbu Grounds, Cebu City Hall, as reflected in the official route map. 

Motorists are advised to take alternative routes, expect traffic buildup near the area, and follow traffic enforcers on site. | 📷: CCTO via Lyle Andales #CDNDigital 

For more news about Cebu and beyond, visit https://t.co/nWCmctdteW.
